blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Why does my disposal hum but not work?
items.answer: Usually something is jammed in it. Don't keep running it. If the reset button and a turn with the hex key don't loosen it, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace my disposal?
items.preview: If it's leaking from the housing or old, replace it.
items.answer: If it's leaking from the body or over 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: What shouldn't go in a garbage disposal?
items.preview: Grease, bones, fibrous food and coffee grounds.
items.answer: Grease, bones, fibrous foods like celery, eggshells and coffee grounds cause most problems.

items.q: Can you install a disposal where there wasn't one?
items.preview: Usually, if there's power under the sink.
items.answer: Usually. We need an outlet or wiring under the sink and the right drain setup.

items.q: Why does my dishwasher back up into the sink?
items.preview: Often a clogged disposal or drain line.
items.answer: Usually the disposal or the drain past it is clogged, so dishwasher water has nowhere to go. Clearing the disposal or the line fixes it. If the disposal is new, the knockout plug may still be in place.

items.q: Can a disposal work with a septic system?
items.answer: Some disposals are made for septic systems. If your home is on septic, tell us before we install.

items.q: Why is my disposal so loud?
items.answer: Something stuck inside, loose mounting or worn bearings. We'll find out which.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal replacement cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and the connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
